    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa")

noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(
      date,
      label = TRUE
    ),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10
  )
```

#Maximum vs Minimum Temperature

```{r}
temp_scatter =
  noaa_df |>
  filter(
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin)
  ) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  labs(
    x = "Minimum Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    title = "Maximum vs Minimum Temperature"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(temp_scatter)
```

### Average Maximum Temperature by Month

```{r}
monthly_temp =
  noaa_df |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(
      tmax,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

temp_line =
  ggplot(
    monthly_temp,
    aes(
      x = month,
      y = mean_tmax,
      group = 1
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    title = "Average Maximum Temperature by Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(temp_line)
```

#Snowfall Distribution
```{r}
snow_histogram =
  noaa_df |>
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = snow)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    x = "Snowfall (mm)",
    y = "Number of Observations",
    title = "Distribution of Positive Snowfall"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(snow_histogram)
```

#Average Precipitation by Month

```{r}
monthly_prcp =
  noaa_df |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    mean_prcp = mean(
      prcp,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prcp_bar = ggplot(monthly_prcp, aes(x = month, y = mean_prcp)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Precipitation (mm)",
    title = "Average Precipitation by Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(prcp_bar)
```
